title: Replace a Pending Change
description: Return to the word in Texts. Press Ctrl+Z (⌘+Z on macOS) to take back the last staged choice, or stage the new choice for the same place. There is no on-screen Undo button, and Ctrl+Z takes back only the most recent staging action. Read the word's current context before making another choice. Undo affects staging only and does not reverse an applied Proposal.
